native_state: one raw mesh with identity world transform; no modifiers, parent, constraints, shape keys, animation or drivers
topology: connected closed orientable; holes H=rows*columns; Euler characteristic 2-2H; genus H
pair_policy: No assembly pairs or pair whitelist; all geometry is one connected shell
normal_policy: rev1 analytic custom face-corner normals with true roundover geometry; corner vectors are numerically compared after native storage and GLB axis conversion, tolerance in current checker
ligament_policy: native report gives actual front/back mouth polyline sample distance and conservative lower bound, no continuous interior solid-thickness guarantee
input_domain_guarantee: strict finite input/coupled constraints only; finite sampled meshes do not prove all continuous parameter combinations
limits: No GPU or actual mobile rendering
BVH shared-vertex exclusion and numerical near-coplanar thresholds remain

production_sampling.historical_sampling: 32-point development assets are archived separately; their reports are not production passes
